messages:
maya: Quick async check — getting llamaX v1 ready for hosted serving. Need status on: weights location, tokenizer edge-cases (BOS/SEP tokens), and a smoke config validation we can run before canary. Also want a small regression eval (golden prompts + structured output) and a tool-calling test. Anyone on this?

kevin: weights are uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-models/llamaX/v1/weights.pt and s3://redwood-models/llamaX/v1/quant/ for int8. README in the bucket has SHA256.

kevin: note — weights naming changed from previous releases (no _v2 suffix). Update loader accordingly.

sasha: tokenizer issue: the repo tokenizer adds a leading <s> token and the tokenizer.json maps it to id 1, but our serving runtime expects BOS=0. That causes prompt offset by 1 for structured outputs.

maya: ugh — thanks. Is it just a mapping fix or do we need to rebuild merges?

sasha: should be remap only. Quick patch: set special_tokens_map = {"bos_token": "<s>", "bos_token_id": 1} in the token config OR remap to 0 at load-time. I can PR the remap.

jon: I can add a runtime compatibility flag: --token-remap-bos=1->0 so we don't re-export models. Would that help for Dedicated customers?

maya: yes please — quick toggle is ideal. Keep model export untouched.

emma: for smoke config validation, use this command: 
```
python -m rwinf.validate_model \
  --weights s3://redwood-models/llamaX/v1/weights.pt \
  --config configs/llamaX_v1.json \
  --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/llamaX/v1/tokenizer.json
```
It checks shapes, kv-cache layout, and a short generate.

emma: example output: 
```
[OK] weights shapes match config
[WARN] tokenizer bos_id != runtime_bos (1 != 0)\n[INFO] generation smoke passed (latency 45ms)
```

maya: perfect. Can someone run that in CI before we flip canary?

ci-bot: ci/model-smoke — started for branch feature/llamaX-onboard (job #3421).

kevin: I'll kick off a run on a g4dn instance. If tokenizer warning persists, I'll attach logs.

kevin: quick FYI re: config: max_sequence_length in model config is 4096 but runtime default is 2048. We need to validate or explicitly set --max-seq for serving.

jon: will add config validation rule to fail if model.max_sequence_length > runtime.max unless explicit override present. Pushing change now.

sasha: about regression evals: I propose a 30-prompt golden set that covers structured JSON output, date normalization, and tool-calling stubs (e.g., call_search, call_calc). We should assert exact JSON shapes and tool call intents.

maya: agree. Can you draft the golden set? We'll lock it then run two generations per prompt (sampling deterministic + top-p) and diff tokens.

sasha: yes. Drafting now and will put it under tests/golden/llamaX_v1.json. Also adding a simple eval harness that checks schema using jsonschema.

emma: tool-calling test: make sure the tool schema returned is exactly {"name":..., "arguments": {...}}. I had a failure earlier where the model returned plaintext instead of the tool object.

kevin: saw that — caused by the tokenizer remap (off-by-one) shifting the bracket tokens for some prompts. Once remap is applied, tool calls line up.

ci-bot: ci/model-smoke — job #3421 failed on step "integration:tokenizer-check" (exit code 1). Logs: "tokenizer bos_id mismatch, and token-to-string roundtrip failed for 3 tokens."

maya: ok, priority: sasha remap PR + jon runtime toggle + kevin re-run smoke. Sasha do you have the PR ready?

sasha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/128 — remap logic + tests. Also added a tiny conversion script: scripts/convert_bos_id.py

jon: runtime toggle PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/899 — adds --token-remap-bos and a validation error to CI if both remap and model export mismatch.

kevin: I'll re-run after those merge. ETA ~30m for my run.

maya: once we have passing smoke, let's do a canary with 5% traffic for 24h, run the golden set every 2 hours, and monitor structured-output diffs.

emma: adding monitors: structured-output-regressions, toolcall-fidelity, latency_p50_p95. Will attach dashboards.

kevin: re: weights: recommended quant config in bucket is configs/quant/int8_llamaX.yaml — follow that for Dedicated.

maya: thanks all. I'll post final go/no-go in this thread after the canary policy is applied.

jon: ping me for release notes — I'll add runtime flags and known tokenizer caveat.

ci-bot: ci/model-smoke — job #3422 started (re-run after PRs).

kevin: started manual canary prepare (allocating nodes). Will update when canary traffic flipped.

maya: thanks — good progress.

sasha: uploading golden prompts now. Link: internal:/tests/golden/llamaX_v1.json

kevin: CI #3422 passed. Smoke checks clean. Rolling canary to 5%.

ci-bot: deploy/canary — canary started for llamaX v1 at 2026-03-17T15:12:30Z (5% traffic).

maya: tracking — will watch dashboards and post any regressions here.

emma: first golden eval completed: 0 regressions. Next run in 2h.

maya: closing loop: thanks everyone. If any regressions pop, revert policy is documented under runbooks/canary-revert.md.

kevin: noted. I'll open a follow-up thread if we need additional tokenizer tuning.
